lineage.hypothesis: A perturbation changes expression by the sum of its genes' single-gene changes in training (additive model).

most_useful_features.description: Additive single-gene response scaled by log1p of the average control mean expression of the perturbation's target gene(s).
Product of target_control_mean_scaling_e32 and a binary indicator (1 for pair perturbations, 0 for singles).
Sum of log1p(control mean expression) over all target genes of the perturbation.
Product of log1p(mean control expression) and log1p(variance of control expression) of the perturbation's target gene(s); summed over pair targets.
Square of log1p(mean control expression) of the perturbation's target gene(s); sum of squares for pairs.
Percentile rank of the mean control expression of the perturbation's target gene(s) among all genes.
Square of the product of log1p(mean control expression) of target gene(s) and binary pair indicator.
Cosine similarity between the training mean-response profile of gene g and the training mean-response profile of the target gene(s) of p.
Product of gene g control mean and average target control mean.
